# Inherited owner-formal default accessors

Genuine Kotlin compatibility interfaces form a two-edge invariant generic
chain. Each child has an original static compatibility accessor for a default
body declared only by the root. Frozen deepest-interface calls, reflection and
method handles must bypass a concrete override while the original default body
keeps virtual duration/velocity calls. All three input identities, nulls, long
high bits, ordered effects and failures are compared with independent original
compiler execution.

Complete original generic signatures, runtime definitions, metadata and
Exceptions are checked after only the reported body helper and static accessor
synthetic flag changes. The nominal bound is checked as an unchanged dependency
input as well. Four wrong programs must be detected.
